speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness since your delivery; can you tell me exactly when your fever started and what your highest recorded temperature has been?

To better understand your situation, how many weeks postpartum are you, and have you noticed any unusual discharge from your uterus or any changes in your breast milk production?

Finally, have you experienced any difficulty urinating, or have you noticed any redness and swelling around your surgical incision site if you had a C-section?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for those details; since you had a prolonged labor and now have decreased bowel sounds with uterine tenderness, could you confirm if you have passed any gas or had a bowel movement in the last 24 hours, and do you have any nausea or vomiting?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Urinalysis, and Serum_Lactate.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Uterine tenderness. I also have Decreased bowel sounds, Increased frequency of urination, Fever. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with secondary Paralytic Ileus.

Based on your prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, fever, and decreased bowel sounds, this strongly suggests an infection of the uterine lining causing inflammation and a temporary cessation of bowel function. The urination frequency may indicate bladder compression from a boggy uterus or concurrent cystitis. Have you noticed any foul-smelling lochia or severe lower abdominal distension?

REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound.
